beats.headline: Robert the Human
beats.text: Donut's first opponent in the house is a hunched man of about seventy, twitching, in a white, old-school sailor's outfit much too small for him, with a nametag reading Gene and a note floating over him that says Robert the Human, level 40. A tall, faceless doll in a sailor suit fights on his side. Just as Geraldo goes for the doll, Mongo flies through the air and chomps onto Robert's throat, and the fight is over. The first thing Donut does is collect the dead man's sailor hat.

beats.headline: Nice dixie cup
beats.text: Donut wears the white sailor hat cockeyed on her head, and it looks ridiculous. Nice dixie cup, Carl says: she looks like she is in the navy. She thinks it divine. It costs her the new Hover skill and ten intelligence, but she has talked to Mordecai: she will wear it until she runs out of cards, then put her new dragonfly tiara back on. It lowers the card-draw countdown by two seconds, and it is quite jaunty. Carl did not know there was magic gear made for the cards.

beats.headline: Under eight seconds
beats.text: In a card duel under the heat lamps, Donut holds a single card when another appears in her hand, giving her two. The next will come in just under eight seconds, thanks to her sailor hat, while the turkey guard roars, charges toward Carl, and turns gobbling on Skylar Spinach when the snake smacks him with its tail.

beats.headline: Sunglasses and the hat
beats.text: A poet is charming them with poetry, and Donut finds it very unrealistic. Carl casts Wisp Armor on himself against the charm, and Donut casts Clockwork Triplicate on Mongo. Calmer now after her first panic, she pops her sunglasses back on and switches to her sailor hat, with its two seconds off the draw countdown on her cards.

beats.headline: Back to the sailor cap
beats.text: Two decks to handle at once: offence against Amayon, whose six totems must die before he can be talked to, and defence against the Vinegar Bitch, whose deck must not run dry for ten minutes. Donut looks terrified and puts on a brave, determined face. She has switched back to her sailor cap. It used to look ridiculous on her, especially with the sunglasses, but now it seems more appropriate, in a way Carl cannot explain.
